summary.text: ASM posted 373-10 in their first innings with Sibsankar Roy scoring 143 off 295 balls, while Umesh Yadav took 5 for 70. PUN responded with 478-6 declared, featuring Emanjot Singh Chahal with 114 off 137 balls and Swarupam Purkayastha claiming 2 for 64. ASM reached 157-6 in their second innings, led by captain Denish Das with 45 off 69 balls as Umesh Yadav picked up 2 for 11, resulting in a drawn match.
